about.title: About Find My Family
about.content: Find My Family was built in response to the catastrophic flash floods and landslides that struck Nepal, severely affecting settlements along the Bhotekoshi and Trishuli River systems. The disaster has caused widespread destruction of infrastructure, including houses, roads, and bridges, leaving hundreds missing and displacing thousands of families. Our mission is to facilitate the rapid sharing of information between those looking for loved ones and those who have found individuals needing help. We are a volunteer-driven platform operating in collaboration with local community efforts.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data Policy
privacy.content: During crisis response, rapid information sharing is vital, but so is the protection of vulnerable individuals. All data submitted to Find My Family—including names, locations, and photographs—is used strictly for the purpose of family reunification and disaster response coordination. We do not sell or monetize personal data. Verified officials and NGOs may be granted priority access to assist in rescue efforts. You may request the removal of a case at any time once a person is marked as Reunited.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Submit details about a missing person or someone you have found. Include identifiers like clothing, age, and location.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our system cross-references missing reports with found reports to suggest potential matches.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Community volunteers and officials verify the matches to ensure accuracy before contacting families.
